entry.name: barSize
entry.label: Bar size: small, medium or large. Scales the indicator glyphs (16/18/22 px), their text (11/12/13 px), the battery percentage (12/13/15 px) and, through the shell scripting API, the Fab OS clock (Inter 12/13/15) — one size for everything in the bar.

entry.name: magnify
entry.label: Magnify the indicators' glyphs (and the dock's icons, kept in sync both ways) when the pointer hovers them. The dock's magnification strength is the dock's own setting.

entry.name: showSpeed
entry.label: Show the live download/upload rate beside the network glyph whenever a link is up (0 kB/s when idle; hidden only without a link).

entry.name: pollSeconds
entry.label: Seconds between probes while the pane is closed: each one is one small script (sh + awk, plus one nmcli call for the active Wi-Fi signal while a wireless link is up) that reads the kernel's network counters, battery and backlight; the full probe (NetworkManager, Bluetooth, volume, power profile, night light) runs every 30 s while closed, every 2 s while the pane is open, and right after each action.

entry.name: tilesJson
entry.label: The pane's tiles: a JSON array of {id, size, enabled} in display order. size = small (half a row) or wide (a full row). Ids: wifi, bluetooth, volume, brightness, battery, netspeed, notifications, dnd, powerprofile, nightlight, screenshot, settings; unknown ids are ignored, missing ones appended with their defaults. Edited with the pane's pencil (drag to reorder, size toggle, remove) or on the applet's settings page; "Reset to default" writes an empty string.
